question: How many open claims does each Southeast adjuster have?

report.interpretation: Open claims (status = 'open' on the 2026-09-30 extract date) currently assigned to each adjuster whose region is Southeast. This covers all report dates and includes adjusters who have left.
report.answer: Four Southeast adjusters hold all the open claims, 206 in total. Michelle Hebert has 60, Pamela Rojas 54, Patricia Carr 48 and Brittney Watkins 44. Kayla Rodriguez (left 2026-05-15) and Theresa Wilson (left 2026-05-01) have none. The most recently reported claims may be incomplete because claims are reported late.
report.answer_sql: select a.adjuster_id, a.full_name, count(c.claim_id) open_claims from adjusters a left join claims c on c.adjuster_id=a.adjuster_id and c.status='open' where a.region='Southeast' group by all order by open_claims desc
